description: This file defines a dialog component for the CKEditor rich text editor, specifically a 'textarea' dialog used for inserting or editing textarea elements within the editor. It registers dialog settings including title, size, behavior on show and on OK, and form fields for 'name', 'cols', 'rows', and 'value'.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog by setting up existing textarea element if one is selected in the editor.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or updates the textarea element in the editor with the data entered in the dialog.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields based on the selected textarea element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies dialog field values to the textarea element.
